description: Source code for the CMSDK APB Watchdog driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing watchdog functionality including initialization, setup, disable, feed, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: wdog_cmsdk_apb_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks access to watchdog configuration registers by writing a specific unlock value.

methods.name: wdog_cmsdk_apb_setup
methods.description: Configures and starts the watchdog timer with specified options.

methods.name: wdog_cmsdk_apb_install_timeout
methods.description: Sets the reload value and callback for the watchdog timeout.

methods.name: wdog_cmsdk_apb_feed
methods.description: Feeds (kicks) the watchdog to prevent timeout.

methods.name: wdog_cmsdk_apb_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog device, sets default reload, and configures NMI handler if enabled.

methods.name: wdog_cmsdk_apb_has_fired
methods.description: Checks if the watchdog has triggered an interrupt.

methods.name: wdog_cmsdk_apb_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for watchdog NMI, reboots if watchdog fired.
